notes: Each row is one Republic, RQII or region, for one month or a whole year (month = All).
status is on_target, close (within 10% of the target) or off_target. KPIs with no target have status null.
prior_year_value is the same month a year earlier, or the previous year total when month is All. change = value - prior_year_value.
better is whether that change moves toward the preferred direction. A zero change leaves better null.
For percent KPIs, change is in percentage points. For AZN KPIs, change is AZN. For the rest, change_percent is the percent change versus the prior year.
dq, ns and cc are synthetic. The others are from the operational exports.
2026 year totals run to August for gas and billing, and to 8 October for field data.
scorecard ranks RQIIs worst first for every month and year, using the page rule: mean rank of UFG, collection efficiency, emergency response and leaks per 1,000 customers. Rank 1 is the weakest.
BRQİİ and BRQSD are combined as BRQİİ / BRQSD.
